description: Use this when someone asks about home heating oil or kerosene prices in Northern Ireland (BT postcodes), England, Scotland or Wales. Returns delivered totals in pounds by oil supplier and area, lowest first, with observation time. Northern Ireland covers 300, 500 and 900 litres; Great Britain covers 500 and 1000 litres. Reference prices for sample areas, not quotes for an address. For the Republic of Ireland use tankful_county_supplier_prices.

litres.description: Order size. Northern Ireland prices cover 300, 500 and 900 litres; Great Britain prices cover 500 and 1000 litres.

nation.description: Limit results to one nation. BT postcodes are Northern Ireland.

name: tankful_uk_prices
title: Heating oil prices in Northern Ireland and Great Britain
